title.zh: 给人工复核留一个候选
title.en: Keep a Candidate for Human Review

brief.zh: 模型把一张照片的检测清单筛空了。用两个不同的审核要求，决定何时应让人再看一眼。
brief.en: The detector left an empty list for one photo. Follow two review requirements and decide when a person should look again.

concept.zh: 在同一张照片上可以为不同用途采用不同门槛。
concept.en: Different review needs can use different thresholds on the same photo.

hints.zh: 高门槛适用于严格筛查。要给人工复核留候选，可以把门槛降到模型分数以下。
hints.en: A high cutoff is useful for strict review. To retain a suggestion for human review, lower the threshold below its score.

prompt.zh: 保留全部类别，降低门槛，让这一张图里的人重新出现在清单中。
prompt.en: Keep All classes and lower the threshold so the person is back on the list.

label.zh: 只保留过高门槛的候选

prompt.zh: 沿用全部类别，把门槛提高到该候选的分数以上，让清单为空。
prompt.en: Keep All classes and raise the cutoff above the candidate score, leaving the list empty.
